shots.subject: Claude Code reads the canvas comment and reasons/streams text in the sidebar ("Working…"), explaining the crop math while running an edit

shots.subject: live-collab banner ("Claude is editing this canvas") then the AI-applied recrop lands: photo goes from flat cutout to an oversized torso-filling crop with the stadium/pitch environment now visible behind the subject, both on the card and the reference thumbnail
shots.lighting: dark-theme studio UI, warm stadium tones in the revealed photo
shots.note: best moment in this segment — an AI edit lands and completely changes the shot in seconds; strong 'result in a few seconds' beat, pair with the pre-edit frame (t~53) for a before/after cut

summary: A ~60s mid-sequence chunk (6 of 8) of a raw Maude-studio screen recording: it opens after an AI background-removal has already finished (told, not shown), then follows a full comment-driven iteration loop on an MVP trading-card IG post — selecting the cutout photo, typing a canvas comment asking for an oversized/tighter crop, handing it to the Claude Code chat agent, watching it reason through the crop math for ~15s, and landing on a dramatic recrop reveal in the final 3 seconds where the flat cutout becomes an oversized hero crop with the stadium environment visible. Mostly static UI with legible on-screen text; the only real motion/energy is the final reveal, and there is one long stretch of pure agent 'thinking' text the brief explicitly wants avoided.
